d: The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for leading Soar’s information security strategy, cybersecurity governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. The role ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the company’s information assets, systems, and customer data while supporting business growth and operational resilience.

The CISO will establish and maintain a robust information security framework aligned with Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements, the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) controls, and applicable cybersecurity standards and regulations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Typically 8–12+ years of experience in cybersecurity or information security, including significant leadership experience.
Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining cybersecurity frameworks in a regulated financial institution or fintech environment.
Strong knowledge of SAMA CSF, NCA cybersecurity controls, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and cloud security principles.
Experience with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, incident response, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and third-party risk management.
Proven ability to manage regulatory examinations, cybersecurity audits, and remediation programs.
Excellent leadership, communication, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
Reports to: CEO or another designated executive, in accordance with Soar’s approved governance structure.
Key stakeholders: Board and relevant committees, executive management, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, CTO, IT, Engineering, DevOps, Legal, and external cybersecurity service providers.
Independence: The role should have appropriate authority, access, and independence to escalate significant cybersecurity risks and report material concerns to the appropriate governance body.

The CISO is responsible for information security governance and oversight. Technology and engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the security controls assigned to them. Internal Audit should independently assess the effectiveness of information security controls without assuming operational responsibility for them.

Final alignment note: The job description should be aligned with Soar’s approved organizational structure, applicable SAMA requirements, cybersecurity independence expectations, and any specific regulatory requirements for appointment or qualifications. The certifications and experience listed above are suggested preferences and should not be interpreted as mandatory SAMA requirements unless separately confirmed.
r: Develop, implement, and maintain Soar’s information security strategy, policies, standards, and procedures.
Establish an effective information security governance framework aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
Advise the CEO and senior management on cybersecurity risks, emerging threats, and security priorities.
Report on the company’s information security posture, key risks, and remediation progress to executive management and relevant governance committees.
Ensure compliance with applicable SAMA Cyber Security Framework (CSF), NCA cybersecurity controls, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
Lead cybersecurity assessments, control implementation, evidence collection, and remediation activities related to regulatory examinations and independent audits.
Coordinate with internal audit, external auditors, regulators, and third-party cybersecurity service providers.
Monitor regulatory updates and ensure timely implementation of applicable security requirements.
Maintain accurate documentation of security controls, risk assessments, exceptions, and remediation plans.
Identify, assess, prioritize, and manage information security and cyber risks across the organization.
Maintain the information security risk register and oversee risk mitigation plans.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, and security reviews.
Evaluate the security risks associated with third-party vendors, cloud services, outsourced operations, and technology integrations.
Ensure that security risks are appropriately escalated and accepted only by authorized risk owners.
Oversee security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities.
Ensure effective operation of the Security Operations Center (SOC), SIEM, endpoint protection, and other security monitoring solutions.
Establish and maintain incident response, escalation, investigation, and reporting procedures.
Lead the organization’s response to significant cybersecurity incidents and coordinate containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned.
Ensure timely escalation and regulatory notification of incidents where required.
Establish and enforce identity and access management policies, including least-privilege access and segregation of duties.
Oversee privileged access management, multi-factor authentication, access reviews, and secure remote access.
Ensure appropriate controls for production environments, administrative accounts, and sensitive customer information.
Review and monitor access granted to employees, contractors, and third-party service providers.
Define and oversee security requirements for cloud infrastructure, networks, endpoints, databases, and production systems.
Integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure secure configuration management, encryption, secrets management, logging, and vulnerability remediation.
Work closely with the CTO, engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to embed security into system design, development, deployment, and operations.
Oversee security reviews of APIs, integrations, and critical business applications.
Work with IT and business continuity teams to ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into business continuity and disaster recovery plans.
Oversee cyber recovery preparedness, backup security, recovery testing, and resilience assessments.
Participate in disaster recovery exercises and ensure that identified security gaps are addressed.
Support the organization’s ability to maintain or restore critical services following cyber incidents or technology disruptions.
Establish appropriate controls to protect confidential information, personal data, financial information, and customer records.
Ensure security requirements are integrated into data classification, retention, transmission, and disposal processes.
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to address data protection obligations and security-related customer concerns.
Promote secure handling of customer information across all systems and business processes.
Assess and monitor cybersecurity risks associated with outsourced services, cloud providers, managed security providers, and technology vendors.
Review security clauses, service-level agreements, incident notification obligations, and audit rights in relevant contracts.
Ensure third-party access to Soar’s systems and data is appropriately authorized, restricted, monitored, and periodically reviewed.
Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees and contractors.
Promote a security-first culture across the organization.
Provide specialized guidance to teams handling sensitive data, privileged access, and critical financial operations.
Compliance status against applicable SAMA CSF and NCA requirements.
Percentage of cybersecurity control gaps remediated within agreed deadlines.
Number and severity of unresolved critical vulnerabilities.
Mean time to detect, respond to, and contain security incidents.
Completion rate of privileged access reviews and access recertification.
Security incident response and regulatory reporting timeliness.
Completion and effectiveness of disaster recovery and cyber resilience exercises.
Third-party security assessment coverage and remediation performance.
Employee cybersecurity awareness and training completion rates.

d: Renardet is seeking for a Geotechnical Engineer that should be highly qualified and experienced in their respective field, having professional work experience in the Sultanate of Oman. The Expert will be responsible for providing design, advice and technical assistance on all issues to the related subject and work closely with a dedicated team of engineers. Further requirements for this position are as follows:
Interpretation of ground investigations and development of design parameters.
Shallow and pile foundations, bearing capacity and settlement.
Soil and rock slope stability, retaining structures and slope stabilization.
Proficiency in Rocscience software, including Slide2/3, Dips, SWedge and RocPlane.
Familiarity with Eurocode 7, BS/EN, ASTM and ISRM standards.
Strong technical reporting skills and the ability to work independently are essential. Experience with PLAXIS or RS2/RS3 is an advantage.
q: Bachelor's Degree in civil engineering from reputed institutions (the qualification attained from outside of Oman should have same equivalency from Ministry of Higher Education of Oman.
Membership with the Oman Society of Engineers is a must.
Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in the position in geotechnical field.
Well versed and familiar with Sultanate of Oman and FIDIC Conditions of Contract as well as Oman Standard Specifications of Roads and Bridges.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Prior experience in imparting training shall be advantageous.

q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent and vocational or technical background.

Related Work Experience: Extensive experience and training in general maintenance, electrical or refrigeration, parts inventory and requisition, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
At least 2 years of hotel engineering/maintenance experience.

d: ARRAY, a software development company headquartered in Bahrain, is growing its Quant Dev team. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer with strong mathematical, machine learning and software engineering foundations to join us in Bahrain. Backed by a sovereign wealth fund, we offer long-term job stability and the chance to grow with us.

Quant Dev combines mathematical rigour and engineering excellence. The team builds great products at enterprise scale, using AI to turn multi-modal data into impactful decisions. We come largely from banks, asset managers and applied science backgrounds, and we work where research meets production: applied, deployed and in the hands of clients.

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can take an AI product from requirement to production and lead the build. You combine strong mathematical and machine learning foundations – in classical ML, in LLM and retrieval systems, or both – with software engineering of a high standard. You’ll work with the commercial team to understand what is needed, design the solution and estimate the work, then assemble and lead a small team of Quant Dev engineers to deliver it. This is an applied role: informed by research, but measured by what reaches production and what clients use.
q: Experience delivering AI products into regulated or operationally critical domains – such as financial services, insurance, government or heavy industry – and a record of picking up new domains quickly.
Familiarity with MLOps and LLM evaluation tooling: experiment tracking, model and prompt evaluation, monitoring.
Experience with multi-modal data – time series, documents, video – in production products.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for deploying AI applications; on-prem deployment experience is equally welcome.
Experience with startup culture – adaptability to a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
r: Applied AI/ML: Own the model and system choices inside deployed products – classical ML or LLM, retrieval and agent systems – covering selection, training or prompting, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and improvement.
Product Engineering: Design, build, deploy and operate production-grade software at enterprise scale, owning features end to end, on cloud or on-prem.
Technical Leadership: Assemble and lead junior engineers on a build – plan the work, set the design, review the code, unblock and mentor.
Engineering Standards: Raise the bar through code review, testing, sound design and expert use of AI coding agents – help the team build faster and safer.
Solution Design: Work with the commercial team to understand requirements, design the solution and estimate effort and risk – producing scopes that win deals and hold in delivery.
Product Conception: Contribute to the ideation and shaping of AI-powered products.
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software products, including several years delivering AI/ML systems to production – not prototypes or research notebooks.
Depth in at least one of: classical machine learning (model selection, training, evaluation and the mathematics behind them) or LLM systems (retrieval, RAG, agents, evaluation and fine-tuning).
Strong mathematical and statistical foundations (probability, statistics, linear algebra, optimisation) – able to reason about model behaviour, not just invoke libraries.
Software engineering excellence in Python: system design, testing, version control, code review and CI/CD – beyond modelling code.
Experience leading other engineers on a delivery: planning, design ownership, code review and mentoring.

Able to engage with the commercial team: understand requirements, design solutions and estimate effort. • Independent problem-solver and genuine team player, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Academic background: Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence or a related quantitative field, or a Bachelor’s with an equivalent record of applied mathematical and ML depth.
